title: The Row of Ancestors

steps.prompt: 6 figures stand in a row of numbered chairs, numbered 1 to 6 from the left: the Butler, the Doctor, the Duke, the Heir, the Priest, the Widow. Use the clues, then answer: who stands in chair number 1? (Just the title, like Baron.)
clues: The Duke is somewhere to the left of the Widow.
Exactly 4 chairs separate the Doctor from the Butler.
The Heir is somewhere to the left of the Doctor.
Exactly 0 chairs separate the Heir from the Butler.
The Duke is in an even-numbered chair.

reveal_text: A number is carved under the saddle: 3.
